title: Close the request asking the art director to look at a sprite edit, when that edit is undone
tier_reason: Step 4 was reverted by step 5 but its card stayed open, so the art director read evidence about a pixel that is no longer in the sheet.
ask: Accepted “Read Daniel's hand edit to Obstacle Set”. Step 4 was reverted by step 5 but its card stayed open, so the art director read evidence about a pixel that is no longer in the sheet.
first_action: In HQ's sprite editor, when a revert step is written to hq/data/sprite_edits/<key>/, find the work item filed by each step being undone (the step's filed.work_id) and mark it withdrawn with the reason 'reverted at step N', so it leaves the art director's queue.
source_message: Accepted “Read Daniel's hand edit to Obstacle Set”.
